_doc: State-gaming-commission monthly revenue sources for regional-casino microcaps. States publish casino revenue BY PROPERTY (or by market) monthly on a ~2-5 week lag, months before the operators print. This maps each source to the tickers/properties it covers. Verified live 2026-07-08. Property lists cross-checked vs the operators' latest 10-K property sections (FLL CIK 0000891482). Detection-first: alert on a NEW month posting; parse per-property AGR only where the format is machine-readable (IL CSV export, IN XLSX). CO/NV/MS are region/city-level PDFs = detection + link only (pdfminer not installed).

illinois.notes: ASP.NET WebForms app. The <option selected> on SearchStartMonth/SearchStartYear is the IGB's own pointer at the latest posted month (detection). ViewType=ViewCSV + ButtonSearch.x/.y postback returns text/csv with a per-casino 'Total AGR' column (parse).
coverage: FLL: American Place (Waukegan) — THE growth asset

indiana.notes: Monthly XLSX. Sheet '1 Tax Summary' carries a per-casino 'Win' / 'Taxable AGR' block. Rising Star Casino (Rising Sun) = FLL.

colorado.notes: Colorado is barred by statute from releasing per-casino figures; it publishes by MARKET (Black Hawk, Central City, Cripple Creek). Monthly calendar PDFs named e.g. May2026.pdf. Detection + link only.
coverage: MCRI: Monarch Black Hawk (Black Hawk market)
FLL: Bronco Billy's / Chamonix (Cripple Creek market)
CNTY: Cripple Creek + Central City markets

nevada.notes: Statewide + market-area 'Monthly Revenue Report' PDFs. Nevada reports by area/range, not per-licensee. Detection + link only.
coverage: FLL: Grand Lodge + Stockman's (Lake Tahoe / Carson Valley)

mississippi.notes: DOR posts monthly Gross Revenue by region (North River, Central River, Coastal). Silver Slipper (Hancock County) sits in the COASTAL region. Detection + link only.
coverage: FLL: Silver Slipper (Hancock County) — Coastal region
